name: fist-items-icon-ui
description: Verify original avatar preservation, sixteen uniquely identified closed-fist Shop icons, starter ownership, coin-funded upgrade purchase, themed HUD, modal behavior, and icon feedback.

steps.label: wait for fist shop and HUD

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists') a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Fists') task.wait(.45) local shop=g.GameMenu:WaitForChild('FunctionalHeroShop') local cards,uniqueIdentity,tinted,badges,features,bounded=0,0,0,0,0,0 local identities,variants,baseArts={},{},{} for _,item in ipairs(cfg.Fists) do local card=shop:FindFirstChild(item.name..'ShopCard',true) local icon=card and card:FindFirstChild('ProductArt') local badge=card and card:FindFirstChild('StaticTierBadge',true) local tierText=badge and badge:FindFirstChild('StaticTierNumber') local feature=card and card:FindFirstChild('StaticSignatureFeature',true) if card and icon then cards+=1 local identity=card:GetAttribute('ShopFistIconIdentity') local variant=card:GetAttribute('ShopFistVariantKey') local base=card:GetAttribute('ShopFistArtVariant') if type(identity)=='string' and identity==item.icon and not identities[identity] then identities[identity]=true uniqueIdentity+=1 end if type(variant)=='string' and variant~='' and not variants[variant] then variants[variant]=true end if type(base)=='string' then baseArts[base]=true end if icon.Image~='' and icon.ImageColor3~=Color3.new(1,1,1) and icon:GetAttribute('HeroGauntletTintMatched')==true then tinted+=1 end if tierText and tierText.Text==('T%02d'):format(item.tier) then badges+=1 end if feature and feature.Text==card:GetAttribute('ShopFistSignatureFeature') and feature.Text~='' then features+=1 end local parts=tonumber(card:GetAttribute('StaticPreviewPartCount')) or 99 if card:GetAttribute('StaticPreviewIdentityVersion')=='UniqueFistIconV1' and card:GetAttribute('StaticPreviewChromeCoverage')=='TintBadgeFeatureV1' and card:GetAttribute('StaticPreviewRenderLoop')==false and parts>=5 and parts<=16 then bounded+=1 end end end local variantCount,baseCount=0,0 for _ in pairs(variants) do variantCount+=1 end for _ in pairs(baseArts) do baseCount+=1 end local fist=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet') local runtime=fist and fist:GetAttribute('VisualSystem')=='ItemMatchedClosedFistV3' and fist:GetAttribute('IconIdentity')=='StarterFist' and fist:GetAttribute('FistVariantKey')=='StarterFist:T01' and fist:GetAttribute('SignatureFeature')=='PAD' and fist:GetAttribute('ClosedFist')==true local runtimePartBudget=runtime and fist:GetAttribute('WithinVisualPartBudget')==true and (tonumber(fist:GetAttribute('VisualPartCount')) or 99)<=28 a:Invoke('CloseMenus') return H:JSONEncode({cards=cards,uniqueIdentity=uniqueIdentity,variantCount=variantCount,baseCount=baseCount,tinted=tinted,badges=badges,features=features,bounded=bounded,runtime=runtime==true,runtimePartBudget=runtimePartBudget==true})

steps.label: sixteen Shop fists have unique bounded item-matched icon identities

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local fist=p.Character:FindFirstChild("Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet") local knuckles,mutations,tails,wedges=0,0,0,0 for _,d in ipairs(fist:GetDescendants()) do if d.Name:find("Closed Knuckle",1,true) then knuckles+=1 elseif d.Name:find("Mutation",1,true) then mutations+=1 elseif d.Name:find("Kaiju Tail",1,true) then tails+=1 elseif d:IsA("WedgePart") then wedges+=1 end end local atlasIcons,actionIcons,tabIcons,rowIcons=0,0,0,0 for _,d in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("ImageLabel") and d.Image=="rbxassetid://104014193600358" then atlasIcons+=1 if d.Name=="ActionIcon" then actionIcons+=1 elseif d.Name=="TabIcon" then tabIcons+=1 elseif d.Name=="RowIcon" then rowIcons+=1 end end end local compact=game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled or workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y<520 local titleResponsive=g.StatsPanel.Title.Visible==not compact return H:JSONEncode({closed=fist:GetAttribute("ClosedFist"),tier=fist:GetAttribute("Tier"),display=fist:GetAttribute("DisplayName"),knuckles=tonumber(fist:GetAttribute("KnuckleCount")) or knuckles,mutations=mutations,tails=tails,wedges=wedges,atlasIcons=atlasIcons,actionIcons=actionIcons,tabIcons=tabIcons,rowIcons=rowIcons,menuIcon=g.MenuButton:FindFirstChild("MenuIcon")~=nil,objectiveIcon=g.ObjectiveCard:FindFirstChild("ObjectiveIcon")~=nil,targetIcon=g.TargetWallHUD:FindFirstChild("TargetIcon")~=nil,title=g.StatsPanel.Title.Text,titleResponsive=titleResponsive})

steps.label: starter fist and scalable themed mobile HUD preserve original avatar

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local opened=a:Invoke("OpenTab","Fists") task.wait(.3) local r=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local shop=g.GameMenu:FindFirstChild("FunctionalHeroShop") local shopOpened=shop and shop.Visible or false local hidden=not r.Visible and not g.HeroStatusDeck.Visible and not g.ObjectiveCard.Visible and not g.MobileControls.Visible and not g.MenuButton.Visible local artCount=0 local allLoaded=true if shop then for _,d in ipairs(shop:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("ImageLabel") and d.Name=="ProductArt" then artCount+=1 allLoaded=allLoaded and d.Image~="" end end end a:Invoke("CloseMenus") task.wait(.15) local restored=r.Visible and not g.MobileControls.Visible and not g.MenuButton.Visible and not shop.Visible return H:JSONEncode({opened=opened,hidden=hidden,shopOpened=shopOpened,artCount=artCount,allLoaded=allLoaded,restored=restored})

steps.label: reference shop behaves as a clean modal and restores the current HUD

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke("Reset") c:Invoke("SetStats",{Coins=500,Depth=1}) local buy=c:Invoke("BuyFist","Boxing Glove") return H:JSONEncode({ok=buy.ok,coins=buy.Coins,equipped=buy.EquippedFist,owned=buy.OwnedFistsJSON,mult=buy.FistMultiplier})

steps.label: coins purchase and auto-equip the next fist tier

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local label=g.StatsPanel:FindFirstChild("EquippedFist",true) local icon=label:FindFirstChild("StatIcon") local fist=p.Character:FindFirstChild("Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet") return H:JSONEncode({text=label.Text,x=icon.ImageRectOffset.X,y=icon.ImageRectOffset.Y,tier=fist:GetAttribute("Tier"),display=fist:GetAttribute("DisplayName"),style=fist:GetAttribute("FistStyle")})

steps.label: equipped item updates fist model and HUD icon

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local holder=g:FindFirstChild("Toasts") local visibleItems,icons=0,0 if holder then for _,toast in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do if toast:IsA("GuiObject") and toast.Visible then visibleItems+=1 local icon=toast:FindFirstChild("ToastIcon") if icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel") and icon.Visible and icon.Image=="rbxassetid://104014193600358" and icon:GetAttribute("ThemeIcon")=="StarterFist" and icon.ImageRectOffset==Vector2.new(191,187) and icon.ImageRectSize==Vector2.new(70,122) then icons+=1 end end end end local tracked=holder and tonumber(holder:GetAttribute("VisibleItemCount")) or -1 local mode=holder and tostring(holder:GetAttribute("PresentationMode")) or "missing" local holderVisible=holder and holder:IsA("GuiObject") and holder.Visible or false local bounded=visibleItems>=1 and visibleItems<=3 local countSynced=tracked==visibleItems local feedbackType=g:GetAttribute("LastFeedbackType") local valid=feedbackType=="Shop" and holderVisible and mode=="BoundedVisibleQueueV1" and bounded and countSynced and icons>=1 return H:JSONEncode({type=feedbackType,holderVisible=holderVisible,mode=mode,visibleItems=visibleItems,tracked=tracked,bounded=bounded,countSynced=countSynced,icons=icons,valid=valid})
